description: Breakout game made in JavaScript and Pixi.js
readme:
# BreakTheFuckOut **The Atari classic Breakout written in JavaScript and WebGL through pixi.js library**
* used libraries: * [Pixi.js](https://github.com/pixijs/pixi.js) * [Howler.js](https://github.com/goldfire/howler.js)
>Play it [here](http://bonnee.github.io/breakthefuckout/), (run on mobile... what did you expect? :smirk:)
